e38d39ab3018fe14df289058ecbad37fcc82a4f7.summary: BleepingComputer's news report (published 2025-07-08) says Italian police arrested Xu Zewei, 33, at Milan's Malpensa Airport on a U.S. international warrant. Italian media (ANSA) report he is accused of links to the Chinese state-sponsored Silk Typhoon group, also called Hafnium, which has targeted U.S. organisations and government agencies. Reported ties include 2020 attacks on infectious disease researchers and healthcare organisations seeking anti-COVID vaccine data, and later campaigns against the U.S. Treasury's OFAC and the Committee on Foreign Investment. e3dbd3c172440c49bdabb7381a7fdfe04a1c6b60.summary: CPJ feature (1 February 2021) on OceanLotus, also called APT32, a hacking and surveillance operation that experts say is run from Vietnam and targets people who criticise the Vietnamese state, including journalists and rights defenders. Methods named include spear phishing, fictitious news sites and compromised websites that profile visitors. A 2017 campaign reportedly hit 120 sites, 90 of them media and human rights organisations. The article notes use of the Cobalt Strike tool. It does not claim to know whether a government is behind the group.

e39346f641339e304a0d865982cd8cf40827d864.summary: Malwarebytes Threat Intelligence reports a malspam campaign observed in late June 2022 that it attributes to the FIN7 APT group. One sample dropped a secondary payload written in .NET. The vendor says FIN7's current malware is a rewrite of JSSLoader with expanded capabilities, including data exfiltration, and plans to compare it with earlier analyses by other vendors.
